# VContext

> Versioned context for AI coding agents.
> Keep decisions, tasks, docs, and project knowledge in sync across agents, sessions, and machines.

## Docs
- Website: https://vcontext.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/VeguiDev/vcontext
- Cloud app: https://app.vcontext.dev

## Install
- Shell: curl -fsSL https://vcontext.dev/install.sh | bash
- PowerShell: irm https://vcontext.dev/install.ps1 | iex

## What is VContext?
VContext is a versioned context layer for AI coding agents. It stores decisions, tasks, documentation, changes, and project knowledge in a structured, branchable, and synchronizable format. Agents access context through CLI or MCP. Context is stored locally in a project-scoped SQLite database, with optional Cloud sync.

## Key concepts
- Project: A named collection of context associated with a codebase.
- Branch: A named line of context history, parallel to Git branches.
- Snapshot: An immutable point-in-time capture of context state.
- Document: Structured project documentation (architecture, specs, notes).
- Task: Tracked work items with status.
- Change: A recorded note about a project modification.
- File context: Descriptions attached to files and directories.
- MCP: Model Context Protocol — the standard VContext uses to expose context to AI agents.

## Integrations
- OpenAI Codex (via MCP)
- Claude Desktop (via MCP)
- OpenCode (via MCP)
- Terminal (via CLI)
- Git repositories (via hooks)
- Any MCP-compatible client
